aeo.q1: Where do I board this route?
aeo.a1SameStop: Board at {first}. The route turns around at {turnaround} and returns to the same stop.
aeo.a1SameNameReturn: Board at {first}. The route turns around at {turnaround} and returns to {last}.
aeo.a1DistinctTerminal: Board at {first}. The turnaround stop is {turnaround}, and the final stop is {last}.
aeo.a2Single: The checked departure time is {firstBus}. Check the latest service information before travel.
aeo.q3: What days does it run, and how often?
aeo.a3unknown: Headway has not been confirmed. Check Kakao Map before riding.
aeo.q4: What information has been checked on this page?
aeo.a4scope: The route endpoints, stop list and displayed operating times have been checked. Fare, operator, reservation and app requirements are not presented as confirmed until they are separately verified.
aeo.a4TemporaryFree: The currently confirmed fare is temporarily free, and a transit card must be tapped when boarding and alighting. Reservation and app requirements are not shown until officially confirmed.
aeo.a4Reverification: The fare needs to be re-verified because an earlier transition window has arrived. No amount is shown until a current official fare is confirmed.
aeo.a5: This site does not provide real-time arrival information. Check Kakao Map for the latest status.
aeo.q6: What should I check before riding?
aeo.a6: Confirm the schedule, stop locations, and service status through Kakao Map or official operator sources before boarding.
aeo.a6link: See our full guide: How to ride →
aeo.q7: When was this information last checked?
aeo.a7: Stops and listed times were checked on {date} against Kakao Map data provided by the Seoul Metropolitan Government.

q1.a1: Buses: App and reservation requirements may vary by service. If confirmed details are not shown, check the latest official service information before riding.
q1.a2: Robotaxis: Yes. Kakao T is used to request service.

q2.a1: Most listed services are public pilot routes. International visitors can usually ride if they follow the route or app instructions.

q3.a1: Buses: Use T-money or a contactless card where accepted. Fare rules may vary by route.
q3.a2: Robotaxis: Payment is handled in Kakao T.

q4.a1: No. Information reflects checked stops and listed times and may not reflect live status. Always check before riding.

q5.q: What should I check before riding?
q5.a1: First/last service times, day of operation, and current operating status via the official source.

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.intro: How we collect, verify, and present route information for Seoul's autonomous services.

sources.item1: Kakao Map route information provided by the Seoul Metropolitan Government
sources.item3: English stop names are sourced from the Seoul Metropolitan Government’s “Multilingual Bus Stop Name List” (updated March 14, 2025; KOGL Type 1). This site uses a selected subset of stop IDs and English names from that dataset.

verification.item1: Autonomous-route stops and listed times are checked manually against Seoul Metropolitan Government information shown in Kakao Map
verification.item2: Night-bus fares and transfer guidance are based on official Seoul notices
verification.item3: We do not provide real-time arrival information
verification.item4: Always confirm with Kakao Map or official sources before riding
verification.item5: Each route shows the date its information was checked

accuracy.item1: Checked and unconfirmed information is clearly separated
accuracy.item2: Unconfirmed details are not guessed and are not presented as established facts
accuracy.item4: Pre-ride confirmation notice is shown for variable information

lastChecked.body: Each route lists the date its information was checked. Information may change between checks. Always confirm before riding.

dataSource.stopNameFallbackNote: Some stops are shown with their Korean names when an official English stop name is not available in the referenced dataset.

about.title: About Seoul Autonomous
about.intro: An independent guide to Seoul's autonomous pilot routes and practical night-bus travel after the last train.

purpose.body1: Seoul Autonomous is an independent guide to two kinds of travel in Seoul: stops and listed times for autonomous bus and robotaxi pilot services, and practical night-bus information for travel after the last train.
purpose.body2: This is not a real-time transit app. It is a curated reference for pilot service routes.
purpose.note: It separates checked information from details that have not yet been confirmed for international visitors and late-night travelers in Seoul.

dataPolicy.body: Unconfirmed details are not presented as established facts. See the data source page for how information is checked.

verification.body: Each route page shows the date its information was checked. Always confirm operating status with the operator or official sources before riding.
